name: Ancient Silver Dragon
summary: A gargantuan metallic dragon that breathes cold or paralyzing gas, casts frost spells, and takes legendary actions.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Paralyzing Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/ice-knife}* (level 2 version).

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. *First Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. *Second Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

atWill.note: Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Chill
items.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *{ref:spell/hold-monster}*. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Cold Gale
items.onFailure: and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon.
items.onFailureOrSuccess: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
